summary: Educational game investigating the problems that probes and rovers have developed on their missions and how NASA Engineers have overcome them.
details:
We have researched a number of NASA missions to or in the vicinity of Mars. Looking at the problems these missions have encountered, we have created an online investigation game based around these mission problems, the causes and the solutions employed by NASA engineers.

We have included links to source information for further details.


The website is written in HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
projectRefs: What really happened on Mars Rover Pathfinder
